tier1.text: Each superior colliculus combines information about where things are seen, heard and felt. The superior colliculus also uses what we see to start eye movements. Each superior colliculus sits at the top of the midbrain, the middle region of the brain. A colliculus is a bump, and the name means “little hill” in Latin.
